sections.title: MEAN (ARITHMETIC AVERAGE)
sections.key: Mean = Sum ÷ Number of observations. Sum = Mean × Count. Adding k to every value raises the mean by k; multiplying by k multiplies the mean by k.

sections.title: MEDIAN
sections.key: Arrange the data in order FIRST. For an odd count the median is the ((n+1)/2)th value; for an even count it is the average of the (n/2)th and (n/2 + 1)th values.

sections.title: MODE
sections.key: The mode is the value occurring most often. No repeats to no mode. Two values tied to bimodal. Three or more tied to multimodal (no unique mode).

sections.title: MEAN/MEDIAN/MODE — REVERSE (FIND MISSING VALUE)
sections.key: Work backwards from Sum = Mean × Count. For AM and GM of two numbers: their sum = 2 × AM and their product = GM2.

sections.title: BAR GRAPH READING
sections.key: Read the height of each bar. Total = sum of the bars; average = total ÷ number of bars; range = tallest - shortest.

sections.title: PIE CHART READING
sections.key: Percentage share = (sector angle ÷ 360) × 100. Value of a sector = (its percentage or angle share) × total. The whole circle is 360° = 100%.

sections.title: HISTOGRAM & FREQUENCY POLYGON READING
sections.key: A histogram has touching bars for continuous class intervals; a bar graph has gaps for separate categories. Class mark = (lower limit + upper limit)/2. Total observations = sum of all frequencies.

sections.title: RANGE & SIMPLE DISPERSION
sections.key: Range = Maximum - Minimum. A range of 0 means every value is identical. The mean is the measure most affected by extreme values.

sections.title: BASIC PROBABILITY
sections.key: Probability = Favourable outcomes ÷ Total outcomes, and it always lies between 0 and 1. P(event) + P(not event) = 1. A coin has 2 outcomes, a die has 6, a deck has 52 cards (4 aces, 13 of each suit).

sections.title: DATA REPRESENTATION CONCEPTS
sections.key: Mean = arithmetic average, Median = middle value, Mode = most frequent value. A pie chart totals 360°; a histogram shows continuous data.
